$schemaNote: Machine-readable inventory of canonical STANDARD settings (NtscEffectFullSettings, numeric IDs 0..61) from pinned ntsc-rs add90f5bf1bf7e3c573e4e945a16f44a82941b51. Extracted by source inspection (no network/cached deps, so the descriptors API could not be executed). Easy-mode settings (IDs 4096+, settings/easy.rs) are a separate ID space and out of scope.
defaultSemantics: Defaults are NtscEffect::default() (settings/standard.rs:399-442) with sub-struct Defaults; FullSettings::default() = From(NtscEffect::default()). Group defaults: Options Some(..) => enabled:true. Group/boolean serialize as JSON bool; enums as u32 index; percentage/float as f32; int as i32. JSON preset loader clamps numeric values to descriptor ranges (settings.rs:677-692) and starts from legacy_value() (standard.rs:1191-1249).
legacyValue: filter_type=ConstantK(0); luma_smear=0.0; head_switching.mid_line disabled; composite_noise {freq 0.25, detail 1}; luma_noise disabled; chroma_noise {freq 0.05, detail 1}; vhs edge_wave {freq 0.05, detail 1}, sharpen {freq 1.0}; all else = default.

runtimeTraps.chroma_loss_1: intensity 1.0 blanks ALL rows, no panic (Geometric ln(0)=-inf -> gap 0); 0.0 gated off (ntsc.rs:1101,1409)
runtimeTraps.comb_fallback: 1/2-line comb falls back to Notch at height 1 (ntsc.rs:488-495)
runtimeTraps.headswitch_noop: offset>num_rows (after vscale) -> whole stage returns (ntsc.rs:728); rows=0 -> empty-slice no-op, no div-by-zero
runtimeTraps.luma_smear_rate: rate arg is hscale, NOT NTSC_RATE (ntsc.rs:578)
runtimeTraps.phase_offset_wrap: offset wraps mod 4 incl negatives via two's-complement &3 (ntsc.rs:282-288)
runtimeTraps.ringing_clamp: freq/hscale clamped 0..1 before notch (would panic otherwise) (ntsc.rs:1281)
runtimeTraps.snow_NaN_edge: anisotropy=1.0 and U==intensity -> 0/0=NaN, measure-zero; GPU must replicate IEEE or guard (ntsc.rs:818-823)
runtimeTraps.vhs_independence: chroma_loss/edge_wave need only vhs group enabled; sharpen additionally needs tape!=NONE (ntsc.rs:1342,1409,1413)

presetFormat.application: ntsc-rs GUI version-1 flat map: {name: value, ..., version: 1}
presetFormat.groupEncoding: group enable flag stored under the group's own name as bool
presetFormat.ntscqtImport: from_ntscqt_json (standard.rs:1273-1447) maps legacy _-prefixed keys; not part of canonical IDs

typeNotes.enum: u32 index into options[]; invalid values rejected on typed get (TryFromPrimitive)
typeNotes.float: f32 inclusive range; logarithmic hints UI slider scale only
typeNotes.group: enable bool + children; disabled group => None at runtime (macro From impls)
typeNotes.percentage: f32 0.0..=1.0 (100%); logarithmic hints UI slider scale only

verifiedBy: Executed pinned Rust descriptors and current defaults; 62 IDs verified. use_field option order corrected to upstream order.

settings.label: Use field
settings.name: use_field
settings.description: Choose which rows ("fields" in NTSC parlance) of the source image will be used.

options.description: Skip every other row, alternating between skipping even and odd rows.
options.label: Alternating

options.description: Skip every lower row, keeping the upper ones.
options.label: Upper only

options.description: Skip every upper row, keeping the lower ones.
options.label: Lower only

options.description: Treat the video as interlaced, with the upper field as the earlier frame.
options.label: Interleaved (upper first)

options.description: Treat the video as interlaced, with the lower field as the earlier frame.
options.label: Interleaved (lower first)

options.description: Use all rows; don't skip any.
options.label: Both

settings.label: Lowpass filter type
settings.name: filter_type
settings.description: The low-pass filter to use throughout the effect.

options.label: Constant K (blurry)
options.description: Simple constant-k filter. Produces longer, blurry results.

options.label: Butterworth (sharper)
options.description: Filter with a sharper falloff. Produces sharpened, less blurry results.

settings.label: Input luma filter
settings.name: input_luma_filter
settings.description: Filter the input luminance to decrease rainbow artifacts.

options.label: Notch
options.description: Apply a notch filter to the input luminance signal. Sharp, but has ringing artifacts.

options.label: Box
options.description: Apply a simple box filter to the input luminance signal.

options.label: None
options.description: Do not filter the luminance signal. Adds rainbow artifacts.

settings.label: Chroma low-pass in
settings.name: chroma_lowpass_in
settings.description: Apply a low-pass filter to the input chrominance (color) signal.

options.label: Full
options.description: Full-intensity low-pass filter.

options.label: Light
options.description: Less intense low-pass filter.

options.label: None
options.description: No low-pass filter.

settings.label: Composite signal sharpening
settings.name: composite_preemphasis
settings.description: Boost high frequencies in the NTSC signal, sharpening the image and intensifying colors.
settings.note: JSON name is composite_preemphasis (legacy ntscQT key); struct field is composite_sharpening.

settings.label: Composite signal noise
settings.name: composite_noise
settings.description: Noise applied to the composite NTSC signal.

children.label: Intensity
children.name: composite_noise_intensity
children.description: Intensity of the noise.

children.label: Frequency
children.name: composite_noise_frequency
children.description: Base wavelength, in pixels, of the noise.

children.label: Detail
children.name: composite_noise_detail
children.description: Octaves of noise.

settings.label: Snow
settings.name: snow_intensity
settings.description: Frequency of random speckles in the image.

settings.label: Snow anisotropy
settings.name: snow_anisotropy
settings.description: Determines whether the speckles are placed truly randomly or concentrated in certain rows.

settings.label: Scanline phase shift
settings.name: video_scanline_phase_shift
settings.description: Phase shift of the chrominance (color) signal each scanline. Usually 180 degrees.

settings.label: Chroma demodulation filter
settings.name: chroma_demodulation
settings.description: Filter used to modulate the chrominance (color) data out of the composite NTSC signal.

options.label: Box
options.description: Simple horizontal box blur.

options.label: Notch
options.description: Notch filter. Sharper than a box blur, but with ringing artifacts.

options.label: 1-line comb
options.description: Average the current row with the previous one, phase-cancelling the chrominance (color) signals. Only works if the scanline phase shift is 180 degrees.

options.label: 2-line comb
options.description: Average the current row with the previous and next ones, phase-cancelling the chrominance (color) signals. Only works if the scanline phase shift is 180 degrees.

settings.label: Head switching
settings.name: head_switching
settings.description: Emulate VHS head-switching artifacts at the bottom of the image.

children.label: Height
children.name: head_switching_height
children.description: Total height of the head-switching artifact.

children.label: Offset
children.name: head_switching_offset
children.description: How much of the head-switching artifact is off-screen.

children.label: Horizontal shift
children.name: head_switching_horizontal_shift
children.description: How much the head-switching artifact shifts rows horizontally.

children.label: Start mid-line
children.name: head_switching_start_mid_line
children.description: Start the head-switching artifact mid-scanline, with some static where it begins.

children.label: Position
children.name: head_switching_mid_line_position
children.description: Horizontal position at which the head-switching starts.

children.label: Jitter
children.name: head_switching_mid_line_jitter
children.description: How much the head-switching artifact "jitters" horizontally.

settings.label: Tracking noise
settings.name: tracking_noise
settings.description: Emulate noise from VHS tracking error.

children.label: Height
children.name: tracking_noise_height
children.description: Total height of the tracking artifacts.

children.label: Wave intensity
children.name: tracking_noise_wave_intensity
children.description: How much the affected scanlines "wave" back and forth.

children.label: Snow intensity
children.name: tracking_noise_snow_intensity
children.description: Frequency of speckle-type noise in the artifacts.

children.label: Snow anisotropy
children.name: tracking_noise_snow_anisotropy
children.description: How much the speckles are clustered by scanline.

children.label: Noise intensity
children.name: tracking_noise_noise_intensity
children.description: Intensity of non-speckle noise.

settings.label: Ringing
settings.name: ringing
settings.description: Additional ringing artifacts, simulated with a notch filter.

children.label: Frequency
children.name: ringing_frequency
children.description: Frequency/period of the ringing, in "rings per pixel".

children.label: Power
children.name: ringing_power
children.description: The power of the notch filter / how far out the ringing extends.

children.label: Scale
children.name: ringing_scale
children.description: Intensity of the ringing.
children.note: JSON name is ringing_scale; struct field is intensity.

settings.label: Luma noise
settings.name: luma_noise
settings.description: Noise applied to the luminance signal. Useful for higher-frequency noise than the "Composite noise" setting can provide.

children.label: Intensity
children.name: luma_noise_intensity
children.description: Intensity of the noise.

children.label: Frequency
children.name: luma_noise_frequency
children.description: Base wavelength, in pixels, of the noise.

children.label: Detail
children.name: luma_noise_detail
children.description: Octaves of noise.

settings.label: Chroma noise
settings.name: chroma_noise
settings.description: Noise applied to the chrominance (color) signal.

children.label: Intensity
children.name: chroma_noise_intensity
children.description: Intensity of the noise.

children.label: Frequency
children.name: chroma_noise_frequency
children.description: Base wavelength, in pixels, of the noise.

children.label: Detail
children.name: chroma_noise_detail
children.description: Octaves of noise.

settings.label: Chroma phase error
settings.name: chroma_phase_error
settings.description: Phase error for the chrominance (color) signal.

settings.label: Chroma phase noise
settings.name: chroma_phase_noise_intensity
settings.description: Noise applied per-scanline to the phase of the chrominance (color) signal.

settings.label: Chroma delay (horizontal)
settings.name: chroma_delay_horizontal
settings.description: Horizontal offset of the chrominance (color) signal.

settings.label: Chroma delay (vertical)
settings.name: chroma_delay_vertical
settings.description: Vertical offset of the chrominance (color) signal. Usually increases with VHS generation loss.

children.label: Tape speed
children.name: vhs_tape_speed
children.description: Emulate cutoff of high-frequency data at various VHS recording speeds.
children.note: NONE disables tape lowpass+sharpen stages but chroma_loss/edge_wave still apply if set.

children.label: Chroma loss
children.name: vhs_chroma_loss
children.description: Chance that the chrominance (color) signal is completely lost in each scanline.

children.label: Sharpen
children.name: vhs_sharpen_enabled
children.description: Sharpening of the image, as done by some VHS decks.

children.label: Intensity
children.name: vhs_sharpen
children.description: Amount of sharpening to apply.
children.note: JSON name is vhs_sharpen; struct field is intensity.

children.label: Frequency
children.name: vhs_sharpen_frequency
children.description: Frequency / radius of the sharpening, relative to the tape speed's cutoff frequency.

children.label: Edge wave
children.name: vhs_edge_wave_enabled
children.description: Horizontal waving of the image.

children.label: Intensity
children.name: vhs_edge_wave
children.description: Horizontal waving of the image, in pixels.
children.note: JSON name is vhs_edge_wave; struct field is intensity. Stage skipped when intensity <= 0 (ntsc.rs:1342).

children.label: Speed
children.name: vhs_edge_wave_speed
children.description: Speed at which the horizontal waving occurs.

children.label: Frequency
children.name: vhs_edge_wave_frequency
children.description: Base wavelength for the horizontal waving.

children.label: Detail
children.name: vhs_edge_wave_detail
children.description: Octaves of noise for the waves.

settings.label: Vertically blend chroma
settings.name: vhs_chroma_vert_blend
settings.description: Vertically blend each scanline's chrominance with the scanline above it.
settings.note: JSON name is vhs_chroma_vert_blend (legacy); top-level bool, NOT inside vhs_settings group.

settings.label: Chroma low-pass out
settings.name: chroma_lowpass_out
settings.description: Apply a low-pass filter to the output chroma signal.

options.label: Full
options.description: Full-intensity low-pass filter.

options.label: Light
options.description: Less intense low-pass filter.

options.label: None
options.description: No low-pass filter.

settings.label: Scale
settings.name: scale_settings
settings.description: Scale the effect by these factors.
settings.note: Disabled group => horizontal_scale=vertical_scale=1.0 and no scale_with_video_size multiply (ntsc.rs:1172-1186).

children.label: Horizontal scale
children.name: bandwidth_scale
children.description: Horizontally scale the effect by this amount. For 480p video, leave this at 1.0 for the most physically-accurate result.
children.note: JSON name is bandwidth_scale; struct field is horizontal_scale.

children.label: Vertical scale
children.name: vertical_scale
children.description: Vertically scale the effect by this amount. You should probably leave this at 1.0.

children.label: Scale with video size
children.name: scale_with_video_size
children.description: Multiply the scaling factors by the video's height. Prefer scaling the input video to 480p instead, which gives much more accurate-looking results.
